newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Yld seen rising on Portugal 5-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Yld seen rising on Portugal 5-yr bonds.

text.p: The average yield was expected to rise to between 5.90 and 5.95 percent at the Institute of Public Credit Management's (IGCP) offer on Tuesday of 25 billion escudos of five-year bonds from 5.7936 percent previously, analysts said.
They said that the recent steadiness of the escudo and the possibility that it could even gain slightly against the mark should encourage interest and ensure that the auction is fully placed.
The results of the auction are due shortly after 1100 GMT.
The IGCP only accepted bids for 10.11 billion escudos at the previous sale on February 14. On the secondary market, the February 2002 bonds have traded between 5.85 and 5.95 percent.
"There could be bids under 5.90 percent, but the majority of bids are slightly above this level," said one investment bank analyst.
But analysts said that the IGCP would probably not accept anything above 5.95 percent.
